title: 自定义字段
description: 自定义模板与字段，按自己的方式整理信息。
author: 资源管理器项目

catalog.usage: 在左侧「筛选」面板按模板筛选当前列表或管理模板与字段，也可一键打开模板表格视图；在素材详情中添加模板。

en.{total} 项有值，其中 {cleared} 项转换不了，会清空: {total} items have values. {cleared} values cannot be converted and will be cleared.
en.选项（改成已有选项会合并）: Options (renaming to an existing option merges the two)
en.{delete} 项的值会清空: Values on {delete} items will be cleared
en.{title} · 点击改名、改类型、管理选项: {title} · Rename, change the type or manage options
en.先在表头点 ＋ 新建字段: Click ＋ in the table header to create a field
en.还没有字段，点击“新增字段”开始。: No fields yet. Choose Add field to begin.
en.从这个素材上移除这个模板: Remove this template from the item
en.带这个标签的素材都挂上同名模板，标签去掉；以后可以给模板加字段: Attach a template of the same name to every item with this tag, then remove the tag. You can add fields later.
en.选一个标签升级为模板: Choose a tag to convert to a template
en.已把标签「{value}」升级为模板（{count} 项），可以撤销（{valu: Converted tag “{value}” to a template on {count} items. Undo with {value3}.
en.双击改名，点击打开模板表格视图: Double-click to rename, or click to open the template table
en.删除模板与对应字段（可撤销）: Delete template and its fields (can undo)
en.按模板「{title}」筛选当前列表；⌘/Ctrl 点击叠加筛选: Filter by template “{title}”. ⌘/Ctrl-click to combine filters.
en.模板名称，回车新建: Enter a template name and press Enter
en.当前范围无模板素材: No items with templates in this scope
en.已删除模板及 {affected} 项上的对应字段，可以撤销（{value2}）: Deleted template and its fields on {affected} items. Undo with {value2}.
en.未能确认使用情况，暂时无法删除。: Usage could not be verified. Deletion is unavailable.
en.仅删除模板定义，目前没有记录使用此模板。: Delete the template definition. No records currently use it.
en.删除模板，并移除: Delete the template and remove the corresponding fields and values from
en.素材、原文件和其他数据保留。: Items, original files and other data are kept.
en.本次删除可整体撤销: This deletion can be undone as one operation
en.自定义模板与字段，按自己的方式整理信息。: Organize information with your own templates and fields.
en.在左侧「筛选」面板按模板筛选当前列表或管理模板与字段，也可一键打开模板表格视图；: Filter by template or manage fields in Filters. Open the template table with one click, and attach templates in the inspector.
